nodes.label: Win Probability & Leverage Index Calibration
nodes.rationale: Innings 1 and 2 Win Probability models used to derive closeness P_close and Leverage Index.

nodes.label: Batting Pressure Index (BPI)
nodes.rationale: Composite pressure index [0, 1] tailored for batters factoring required rate, wickets lost, and leverage.

nodes.label: Bowling Pressure Index (BoPI)
nodes.rationale: Composite pressure index [0, 1] tailored for bowlers factoring phase leverage, set strikers, and chase defense.

nodes.label: Contextual Expected Value (xRuns / xWicket)
nodes.rationale: Ball-level baseline expectation stratified by competition tier, innings, over, and wicket bucket.

nodes.label: Empirical Bayes Shrinkage Regularization
nodes.rationale: Shrinks small sample averages toward conservative replacement prior to prevent fluke sample bias.

nodes.label: Net Batting Value per Ball (v_bat)
nodes.rationale: Run value added minus wicket run value penalty relative to contextual par.

nodes.label: Net Bowling Value per Ball (v_bowl)
nodes.rationale: Runs prevented plus bowler wicket value added relative to contextual par.

nodes.label: Pressure Reliability Rating (PRR)
nodes.rationale: Composite rating combining 50% shrunk high-pressure value, 25% personal baseline delta, and 25% match consistency.

nodes.label: Garbage-Time Chase Filter
nodes.rationale: Caps pressure in dead games (W < 0.02 or W > 0.98 in final 3 overs) to prevent stat-padding rewards.

nodes.label: Competition Quality Weights (w_comp)
nodes.rationale: Weighting system prioritizing IPL (1.00) and Full-Member T20Is (0.90) over Associate/Emerging cricket (0.40).

nodes.label: Dual Baseline Architecture
nodes.rationale: Compares player pressure performance against both contextual expectation and player's own non-pressure usual baseline.

nodes.label: Five Core Pressure Dimensions
nodes.rationale: Mathematical formulation combining tempo pressure, wicket collapse pressure, phase scarcity, match closeness, and knockout stakes.

nodes.label: build_match_state Function
nodes.rationale: Reconstructs cumulative pre-delivery and post-delivery state, balls remaining, target, CRR, and RRR.

nodes.label: load_and_clean_superr_data Function
nodes.rationale: Canonical data loader resolving split IDs, extras1_runs, legal ball flags, and bowler wickets.

nodes.label: convert_cricket_overs_to_balls Function
nodes.rationale: Converts cricket notation like 14.3 overs into exact integer balls (87 balls) handling edge cases.

nodes.label: Critical Data Guardrails
nodes.rationale: Enforces zero-tolerance rules on extras1_runs, legal ball counts, player IDs, bowler wickets, and IPL comp IDs.

nodes.label: Trap 1: extras1_runs Categorical ID
nodes.rationale: extras1_runs is an extras_type_id foreign key (6 on normal balls). Summing it adds +6 runs to every legal ball.

nodes.label: Trap 2: over_ball_num Increments on Non-Legal Deliveries
nodes.norm_label: trap 2: over_ball_num increments on non-legal deliveries
nodes.rationale: over_ball_num counts all attempts (up to 13), not legal balls. Legal ball count must filter out wides and no-balls.

nodes.label: Trap 3: Player Split IDs and Homonyms
nodes.norm_label: trap 3: player split ids and homonyms
nodes.rationale: Merge 4 split IDs (e.g. Basil Hameed 39444->8638) while keeping 3 true homonyms (Rashid Khan, Abdul Samad, Haider Ali) separate by player_id.

nodes.label: Trap 4: Bowler Wicket Attribution & Typo in dismissal_type
nodes.norm_label: trap 4: bowler wicket attribution & typo in dismissal_type
nodes.rationale: Bowler wickets exclude runouts, retired outs, and obstructing field, while accounting for dataset typos.

nodes.label: Trap 5: Competition Quality & T20 Format Tiers
nodes.norm_label: trap 5: competition quality & t20 format tiers
nodes.rationale: Distinguishes IPL, ICC Full Member T20Is, and Associate/Emerging tournaments rather than blind match_format=='T20'.

nodes.label: Trap 6: Super Overs Maximum Leverage
nodes.rationale: Innings 3 and 4 represent maximum leverage tiebreakers where Pressure Index is fixed at 1.0.

nodes.label: Trap 7: DLS Rain-Shortened Match Targets
nodes.rationale: Adjusts targets and scheduled balls using revised_target and second_inn_revised_overs from matches.csv.

nodes.label: Trap 8: playing_eleven Unplayed Bench Squad
nodes.rationale: Filter is_played==True to avoid counting unplayed squad bench members.
